product_metadata.title: Photo Prints – Luster – Standard Size (8x10)
features: Amazon Photos provides high-quality custom prints that are made to order especially for you.
Luster paper has a semi-gloss finish, less shiny than a glossy finish, and more reflective than matte.
Accurate skin tone representation and vibrant colors give a true-to-life look to photos printed on Luster paper.
Superb color stability makes this a print paper of archival quality, exceptionally long lasting.
The most popular print paper, Luster is recommended for any type of photography.
You can always access the photos from your printing projects in Amazon Photos.
description: Select your favorite photos to print on high-quality photo paper, in fade-resistant color. Order your favorite snapshot or create a keepsake gift for a loved one.
